rooms.name: The Silent Tower
rooms.desc:
You stand inside a room-within-a-room in the silent tower. Once a terrible
punishment for magii, a room where magic is impossible, yet now the home of
Antryg. It was he who crushed the power of the church Witchfinders and made
this place his palace.

rooms.name: The Air Elevator
rooms.desc:
The limestone walls of this chamber have been worked smooth. At the center 
is a 5' round flat wood platform circled with a broad band of silver. Ivory 
runes and glyphs are inlaid into the silver band. Ten feet up in the center 
of the ceiling is a 10' wide dark circular opening. This chimney reaches 
upward into the rock as far a you can see. On the east wall is a large brass 
plaque in the common tongue.

rooms.name: Northern End of the Beach
rooms.desc:
The beach ends here as the plateau juts out into the sea.  As you stand 
at the base and look up, you think better of trying to climb it.  Sea spray 
fills your nostrils as the waves continue their relentless assault on the rock
invading it's domain and the roar of the collisions makes hearing difficult.
To the east are more cliffs, to the west a heavy surf.  There is a sign 
attached to a rock here.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark tunnel, the gold no longer lines the walls, just a
pervasive dampness.  The rivulet still meanders down the sandy floor of
the tunnel.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc:
You are in a dark tunnel, the gold no longer lines the walls, just a
pervasive dampness.  The rivulet still meanders down the sandy floor of
the tunnel.

rooms.name: In the Surf
rooms.desc:
You are up to your chest in the surf and the water is cool.  The sand 
swirls beneath your feet and the waves suck at you ominously causing you 
to continually adjust your balance.  There is a large sign with bold 
lettering sticking up from the edge of the surf.

rooms.name: Middle of the Beach
rooms.desc:
You stand at the base of a very steep cliff on a wide sandy beach.  The 
beach stretches to the north and south and to the west the beach slopes
downward reaching out into a pounding surf.  Along the base of the cliff
is chaotic piles of driftwood and storm debris indicating the high-tide 
line.  It looks like you would be safe but might make for an uncomfortable
night as there isn't much legroom at high tide.  The cliff itself is very rough 
and is filled with numerous small cave openings all along the beach, both at 
beach level as well as higher up on the cliffs.  Birds fly in and out of 
many of them.

rooms.name: Beyond the Golden Way
rooms.desc:
Huge chunks of gleaming gold encrust the walls, ceiling and floor for the 
first 10' of this gloomy cavern. A gurgling rivulet of water meanders along 
the sandy floor from the darkness ahead and out of the entrance.

rooms.name: Gate of Iron
rooms.desc:
A badly rusted and corroded iron gate reaching from floor to ceiling and
wall to wall stands here blocking your way inward. The rivulet escapes 
from beneath the decaying portal with scant inches to spare. The floor
here has changed from the sandy floor to hard bedrock.

rooms.name: Inside the Gate
rooms.desc:
Your are on the other side of the now defunct gate. A cool moist breeze
comes from the south and the rivulet is less discernible here, more like a
sheet of water than any organized flow.

rooms.name: The Brass Door
rooms.desc:
A heavily tarnished thick door of brass prevents passage beyond here. 
The door has a keyhole halfway down its left side and no visible handle 
or hinges.

rooms.name: Southern End of the Beach
rooms.desc:
The beach ends here as the plateau juts out into the sea.  As you stand 
at the base and look up, you think better of trying to climb it.  Sea spray 
fills your nostrils as the waves continue their relentless assault on the rock
invading it's domain and the roar of the collisions makes hearing difficult.
To the east are more cliffs, to the west a heavy surf.  There is a sign 
attached to a rock here.

rooms.name: Rain and Moss
rooms.desc:
Cool drops of water rain down from thickly clustered stalactites 
suspended from the ceiling. Dark clumps of moss cling to cave formations
on the floor and wall of the north side of this small cavern. Dark exits
can be seen in the east and north walls.

rooms.name: A Dark Tunnel
rooms.desc: To the west can dimly be seen a large cavern.  To the north the tunnel continues.  The dampness on the walls here seems slightly less.

rooms.name: A L O N G F A L L!!
rooms.desc:
AAAAAIIIIIEEEEEEEEEE!!!!!!!

S        P        L        A        T        !        !        !

You should be more careful around dangerous precipices next time!

rooms.name: North End of Surf
rooms.desc:
You are waist deep in the surf and the rocks underwater are very slippery.  
Combined with the wash of the surf from the base of the cliff, footing is,
shall we say, treacherous. To the north the cliff base still blocks your 
way.  To the west is certain death, to the east is the relative safety of 
the beach.  Maybe you'd better turn back now.

rooms.name: South End of Surf
rooms.desc:
You are waist deep in the surf and the rocks underwater are very slippery.  
Combined with the wash of the surf from the base of the cliff, footing is,
shall we say, treacherous. To the south the cliff base still blocks your 
way.  To the west is certain death, to the east is the relative safety of 
the beach.  Maybe you'd better turn back now.

rooms.name: Deep Surf
rooms.desc:
As  the undertow sucks you down and your lungs 
fill with water, you realize what an ...

I D I O T!!

... you were not to take the warning advice.  Maybe in 
your next life you will use the brain your god gave you.

rooms.name: Deep Surf
rooms.desc:
As  the undertow sucks you down and your lungs 
fill with water, you realize what an ...

I D I O T!!

... you were not to take the warning advice.  Maybe in 
your next life you will use the brain your god gave you.

your next life you will use the brain your god gave you.

rooms.name: The Kitchen
rooms.desc:
Along the west wall of this room is a table with cupboards above and below.
Along the south wall is a thick wood table with several knives and cleavers
stuck in it. Discarded chunks of vegetables litter its top. Recessed into 
the north wall is a large fireplace in which hangs an iron pot above a fire.
The pot gives forth the pleasing aroma of simmering vegetables and spices.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the hallway.  There are doors to the east 
and West.

rooms.name: The Larder
rooms.desc:
Running the length of the east wall from floor to ceiling of this room
are shelves stuffed with boxes and tins. From the north wall protrude three
spigots with symbols painted above them. In the south wall are several bins
also painted with symbols.

rooms.name: Circle of Battle
rooms.desc:
A thirty foot in diameter ring of silver and gold glyphs is inlaid into the
floor here. At the center of the circle is a 3 foot square iron grate. From
beneath the grate comes a red glow.

rooms.name: Bottom of the Pool
rooms.desc:
You are at the bottom of the pool.  It's pretty murky down here.  Did you 
remember to hold your breath?

rooms.name: The Pool
rooms.desc:
A square pool of murky water covered by seaweed is found here. The pool is
fed by streams of water issuing from the mouths of large exquisitely carved
green jade frogs at each corner. The smell of brine and decay hangs heavy in
the air.

rooms.name: Main Store Room
rooms.desc: Many kegs and barrels are neatly stacked in this room.

rooms.name: In the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a short hallway.  The hallway continues to the 
North and south and doors are on the east and west walls.

rooms.name: Guests Dining Hall
rooms.desc:
A 30' long 5' wide table surrounded by chairs runs down the center of
this room. A lone still figure stands stooped over the table. At the east
end is a window showing the forest outside.

rooms.name: Warning Message
rooms.desc:
A message in common tongue has been carved into the stone above the lintel
of the door at the end of this hall. The message reads "CIRCLE OF TESTING
Authorized personnel only. You are entering a restricted zone"

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short hallway that turns to the east and dead ends.  The 
hallway continues to the south and there is a door in the north wall.

rooms.name: Conjurers Quarters
rooms.desc:
The door to this room opens a few inches and then something stops it.
At the foot of his bead in the NE corner is a chest.

rooms.name: Student Evokers Quarters
rooms.desc:
Lying in a bed in the NE corner of this room is an elf with his head 
propped up on a pillow. He holds before him a large open book. His eyes
stare wide open at the book. Hanging over the end of the bed is a robe.

rooms.name: At a Hallway Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are at the junction of two hallways. The Hallways lead east and North.
To the south is a door.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You've reached the end of the hallway.  You can return to the west or there
is a door to the south.

rooms.name: Domed Chamber
rooms.desc:
A milky white translucent substance forms a 20' high domed ceiling here.
At three equidistant points on the floor along the walls are small concave
mirrors pointed at an upward angle toward the center of the room. 
Protruding from each mirror face is a small and delicate, empty, silver 
wire basket.

rooms.name: The Face of Fear
rooms.desc:
You've climbed nearly 70' high when strong winds begin to swirl about. 
Soon a multicolor maelstrom centers itself in the room above you. From its
middle grows larger and larger until it fills the area the visage of an 
angry dark-haired man. He speaks in a booming ominous voice which crackles
with power "Turn back defilers of this place! Or suffer my wrath!"

rooms.name: Halfway Up the Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are halfway up the set of stairs.  The fact that there is no visible 
means of support for the stairs and that there is no railing makes you kind
of uncomfortable.

rooms.name: Lower Tower Chamber
rooms.desc:
A series of marble slabs form steps suspended in mid air and rise upward 
in a spiral along the walls of this chamber. A hidden door in the east wall
slowly opens and from it steps a large manlike creature. An iron band 
encrusted with gems encircles its head. The creature stands at the bottom 
of the stairs mute and unmoving.

rooms.name: Exercise Hall
rooms.desc:
There are two men in nightclothes frozen in fighting stances and wielding
longswords near the middle of this room. On one of the mens head hangs at an
odd angle a jeweled iron ring. A drab curtain covers an area 30' wide 10' 
out from the west wall. There is a door in the north wall and an archway in
the NW corner. A bedraggled looking bearded old man peeks out from behind 
one of the men laughs hysterically and says "The ring of battle is what you
seek. You'll gain a pretty bauble if you be not weak." and points to the 
archway.

rooms.name: Hallway Intersection
rooms.desc:
You are at the intersection of two hallways.  The hallways continue to the 
North, East, and South.  To the west is a door.

rooms.name: A Door Lined Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short door-lined hallway.  There are doors to the north and
South.  The hallway continues east and West.

rooms.name: A Door Lined Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short door-lined hallway.  There are doors to the North, East,
and South.  The hallway continues West.

rooms.name: Top of the Shaft
rooms.desc:
The platform stops gently at floor level and in the center of a 30' square
room. As soon as you step off the platform, it silently drops back down 
the chimney. Peering over the edge, you decide you might want to be very
careful about where you step. There are brass-bound oak doors at the center
of the north, south and west walls.

rooms.name: Lounge Area
rooms.desc:
A large fireplace with flames cheerily dancing within covers the west wall
of this room. Above the fireplace are three dusty portrait paintings and
near it on the north side of the room sits an overstuffed armchair.  Down 
the center of the room lies an oriental rug.  To the north and south are 
single doors and to the east is a set of double doors.

rooms.name: A Short Flight of Stairs
rooms.desc: A short flight of stairs leads down to another set of doors.

rooms.name: Sealed Exit
rooms.desc:
Two windows are in the north and south walls of this room. Through them 
can be seen a pinewood forest not far in the distance. At the center of 
the east wall is another set of double doors.

rooms.name: Doorstep
rooms.desc:
This is the doorstep to Orsilon's house.  You can go no further
than here due to the forcefield.

rooms.name: Guards Quarters
rooms.desc:
Two unmade empty beds are in the far opposite corners of this room. There 
is a wood chest at the foot of each. Above the beds on the wall hangs a small bullet shield embossed with a white sword.

rooms.name: Student Prestidigitators Quarters
rooms.desc:
An empty bed is in the SE corner of this room. Hung by a hook on the North
wall is a robe beneath which is a pair of worn leather shoes. A prone form 
can be detected beneath the covers on the bed.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
This is the Western end of a short hallway. There are doors to the North
and South.  The hallway continues East.

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in the middle of a short hallway.  There are doors to the north and
South.  The hallway continues both east and West.

rooms.name: East End of a Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the Eastern end of a short hallway.  There is a door to the 
South and the hallway continues West.

rooms.name: Captain of the Guards Quarters
rooms.desc:
A full suit of field plate armor hangs on a wood rack in the NE corner. In
the SW corner is a small table littered with wood shavings and various shaped
small knives. In the opposite corner is a large empty bed.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the end of a hallway.  To the north is a hallway intersection.  
To the east is a heavy door.  To the west in another door.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Prison Cells
rooms.desc:
The door to this area is double thick and stands open. There are three 
doors spaced 10' apart on the south wall and a like door is at the end of 
the hall.

rooms.name: Time Stopped Man
rooms.desc:
Inside the cell is a time stopped man on his knees holding a bowl to his
lips.

rooms.name: Slagged Door
rooms.desc:
You stand in the entrance to an overgrown garden. Beyond the door is a
large chamber choked by a thick tangle of thorny rose bushes. The door 
lies in a pile of slag on the floor and is torn off its hinges.

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: There is a well made bed, a table and a chair in this room.

rooms.name: Guest Room
rooms.desc: There is a mussed bed, a table and a chair in this room.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Empty Cell
rooms.desc: The cell is bare and empty.

rooms.name: Short Flight of Stairs
rooms.desc:
You are on a short flight of stairs that goes down to the south and ends
at an ornately carved door.

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: In an Overgrown Garden
rooms.desc:
The rosebushes are extremely tough and you have to fight your way through
them.  Movement is very slow and those damn roses are SHARP!

rooms.name: Small Clearing
rooms.desc:
You are in a small clearing in an overgrown garden.  Rose bushes run 
rampant.

rooms.name: West End of a Long Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are at the western end of a long hallway. A door blocks progress to the
West and the hallway stretches off to the east.

rooms.name: Council Hall
rooms.desc:
This area was obviously constructed as some sort of grand hall or
council chamber. The left and right walls angle away from you a 45
degrees for 30' where they meet the back wall which curves outward for
another 30'. At the end of the west wall is a door. Two highly
polished wood benches are ahead to the left and right. At the southern
end, up a short flight of curved stairs is a large oak throne. On its
back posts are two brightly glowing globes which illuminate the entire
area. Some indistinguishable script can be seen carved into the upper
back of the great chair.

rooms.name: Circular Stone Staircase
rooms.desc: A series of stone stairs spiral downward into the darkness here.

rooms.name: Gem Cutting Room
rooms.desc:
A stout and heavy wood table is against the west wall. In front of the 
table is a chair. On the table are some small hammers and several other 
metal instruments. Above the table hanging on an iron chain is a brightly
glowing ball which lights the area effectively.

rooms.name: Burned Out Library
rooms.desc:
Charred and blackened books fill the burnt remains of shelves along the 
West and North-West walls. The bookshelves and their contents to the 
south are unaffected. In the NE corner is a desk scattered with many 
rolls of parchment. At the center of the north wall, between the burnt 
book cases is a small, dark, arched alcove above which is a stone lintel 
with an inscription carved into it. Near the center of the room is a very
odd sight. A small dark man in faded and worn orange robes is seemingly 
imprisoned in a cage of shimmering bars. Near the cage on its east side 
stands a man with a longsword raised as if to strike. The man is dressed 
in nightclothes and has an iron keyring hanging off his sash.

rooms.name: Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short hallway.  To the north and east are doors, to the west 
is a burnt out library.

rooms.name: Magical Components Storage
rooms.desc:
A confusing array of neatly stacked boxes, bins, bottles, vials, tins 
and various assorted other containers fill a glass cabinet running the 
length and height of the west, north and south walls.

rooms.name: Glassblower Workshop
rooms.desc:
At the center of the east wall of this room is a fireplace. In the middle
of the room is a large 10' square table. A barrel of fine sand sits in the 
NW corner.

rooms.name: A Short Hallway
rooms.desc:
You are in a short connecting hallway.  To the north is a door, to the 
South and intersection.

rooms.name: End of the Hallway
rooms.desc:
You have reached the end of this short hall.  To the north and south are
doors, to the east is the laboratory.

rooms.name: Alchemy Laboratory
rooms.desc:
A long table scattered with sheets of parchment runs along the south wall
between two doors. Running east and west down the center of the room are two
more long tables each cluttered with a confusing array of glass receptacles,
tubes and strangely shaped bottles filled with a manifold display of colored
liquids, some bubbling and frothing.

rooms.name: Four Ways to Go
rooms.desc:
You enter a 30' across octagonal chamber. To the north and south are 
identical doors. To the west is a 10' wide 30' long passage ending at a
door.

rooms.name: Underground Garden
rooms.desc:
The air here is fresh and clean. A bright spheroid of golden light emits 
from the ceiling casting a warm glow all about. A carpet of thick green 
grass dotted here and there with colorful flowers covers the floor. Several
bushes grow in the area. At the center is a 10' wide circular, raised stone
receptacle. Crawling along its top is a large, golden eyed snake like 
creature with green/gold scales and a human like head. The creature stares 
at your party attentively.

rooms.name: Potters Workshop
rooms.desc:
In the NE corner of this room is a large, round barrel. At the center of 
the west wall is a large brick oven. Near the center of the room is a small
round table with a half formed, dried out clay pot lying on it. A wood 
cabinet is in the SE corner.

rooms.name: Mordains Quarters
rooms.desc:
A good sized bed unmade and rumpled is in the NE corner. On the floor is
a badly worn persian rug.

rooms.name: Hidden Lair
rooms.desc: You have entered a small lair of some sort.  The room is rather cramped.

rooms.name: Entrance to Secret Chamber
rooms.desc: You are in a small square room.

rooms.name: The Family Treasure Vault
rooms.desc:
There are two large chests bound in platinum and three large urns chased 
with gold along the north wall of this room.

rooms.name: Seascape Painting
rooms.desc:
Thinking you'd get a better look at the seascape painting, you stepped
a bit closer.  As you approach it, the seascape came to life. You are
now standing on a beach, complete with the smell of the ocean, the cry of
gulls and the feel of sand beneath your feet.  The only way out is back 
East to the bedroom.

rooms.name: Orsilons Quarters
rooms.desc:
A huge sumptuous bed of powder blue satiny material embroidered with 
gold thread floats at knee height centered between the east and west 
walls. At the four corners of the bed, holding it down are golden chains
attached to the floor. The west wall has a lifelike seascape painted across
its entire surface. Next to the wall is a small wood dais atop which rests 
a large conch shell. To the south a series of steps plunge into a half 
circle pool of clear water.

rooms.name: Fourth Level Teleport Room
rooms.desc:
You appear in a small rounded alcove at the center of a wall in a 20' 
square room. There is a waist high stone pedestal with a red gem in its 
center before you. Straight ahead, to the left and to the right are doors.

rooms.name: The Inner Sanctum
rooms.desc:
You have come into the bottom of a triangular room measuring 30' on a 
side. At its center on indistinct wavering form of a robed man can be seen.
He holds in his hands before him a softly glowing globe. The apparition 
floats a few inches above the floor. The man raises his hand, points to the
door behind you and mouths the word go.

rooms.name: Magic Den of the Yeti
rooms.desc:
Suddenly your surroundings have drastically changed. You appear near the
center of a 30' across round room. Snow covers the floor and huge icicles 
hang from the ceiling. The temperature here is very cold. Before you is an 
ice encrusted low stone pedestal. You don't have time to examine it however
as a huge hulking white furred beast is charging toward you.

rooms.name: Magic Den of the Troll
rooms.desc:
You suddenly appear in a 30' in diameter room. Bones litter the floor. At
the center is a low stone dais atop which has been placed a small pile of 
gnawed bones. You don't have time to examine the room more thoroughly as 
there is a huge mottle-skinned green troll is advancing toward you, slavering
jaws agape.

rooms.name: The Bronze Guardian
rooms.desc:
You appear at the far end of a 40' wide 80' long hall. Six stone columns,
three on a side, spaced 20' apart and reaching to the ceiling 20' above 
run down the hall. On each pillar is an iron sconce hold in a lit torch. At
the opposite end is a 20' wide 10' deep alcove. Standing in the alcove is a
tall muscular manlike bronze statue with the head of a dragon and holding a
huge curved scimitar. In its forehead is a brightly glowing yellow stone. A
few paces in front of you is a low round stone pedestal with a large 
gleaming diamond set in its top.

rooms.name: MIMIC LOAD ROOM, DON'T DELETE.
rooms.desc: The mimic loads here, used in the couch special.

rooms.name: On the Platform
rooms.desc:
The limestone walls of this chamber have been worked smooth. You stand in 
the center of a circular wooden platform in the middle of the room. Above
you in the ceiling is a 10' wide dark circular opening. This chimney reaches 
upward into the rock as far a you can see. Looking down, you see a moving shape
through the cracks in the boards.

rooms.name: Entering The Hartland Forest
rooms.desc:
You stand at the entrance to a rather dense forest.  You are
surprised to find that you do not feel any dread at entering such a 
forest, but you actually feel drawn to the forest.  There is an exit 
to the south.
